audience: security, fraud and support teams that check IP addresses with an ipapi.is account

useCases.title: Check if an IP is a VPN, proxy, Tor or datacenter address
useCases.text: Look up one IPv4 or IPv6 address. Read the flags for VPN, proxy, Tor exit, datacenter, abuser, mobile and crawler.

useCases.title: Find the owner and abuse contact of an IP
useCases.text: Look up an address to see the owner company, the network and the abuse contact. Use it to report an attack to the right team.

useCases.title: Screen a list of IPs from your login logs
useCases.text: Send up to 100 IP addresses in one request. Ask the assistant to list the risky addresses and say why each one is risky.

useCases.title: Look up an AS number and its routes
useCases.text: Read the organization, registry, type, country and announced routes of an autonomous system. Use it to see who runs a network.
